outcome: scar status at time of delivery
cohort: 120 women with one previous caesarean section
finding: Prenatal evaluation of the lower uterine segment scar thickness is a valid technique for selecting women who should attempt vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC).
mod_finding: A lower uterine segment scar thickness of 3.1-5mm at 38-40 weeks of gestation is associated with a higher likelihood of successful VBAC.
